saw_lines: Shift managers buy scheduling software after a bad week of missed swaps, then judge it by how fast swaps get approved.
So the sale is won on the first screen, where a manager sees the free plan and decides to keep reading.
Your site quotes a customer who went from 5 hours to 20 minutes of scheduling a month, so lead your next Google text ads with that line.
ads_1: Google text ads led by time saved on scheduling and a free start
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
